## Personality

Phil Gordon possesses a sweet, goodhearted, and loyal nature that lies beneath a frivolous exterior. Though not selfish, she is a little thoughtless and admittedly indecisive, describing herself as inherently unable to stop teetering when making up her mind. Additionally, she has a natural knack for making people like her, has learned skills such as washing dishes and sweeping floors, and harbours a horror of scarlet fever.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Place P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 ch.Relationships P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 ch.Interlude P22](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0022), [v3 ch.Interlude P37](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0037), +3 more_

## History

Philippa Gordon, the daughter of a wealthy and prominent [Bluenose](../codex/factions.md#bluenose) family from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while registering as a freshman at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). She quickly included them in her social circle and confided details about her suitors, [Alec](../character/alec.md) and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md). Later, Phil begged to join [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Priscilla's housekeeping arrangement at Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md). Though she initially struggled to choose between her suitors, Phil fell in love with [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), an earnest theological student, while spending a summer at a boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). After [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) proposed to her, she accepted, embracing her future as a minister's wife. She also hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) for a pleasant fortnight and later comforted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejected Royal Gardner's marriage proposal. Following her college graduation, Phil married [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). She eventually traveled to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to attend Anne's wedding, gifting her Miss Patty's china dogs for the occasion.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Lady P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 ch.Lady P42](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0042), [v3 ch.Lady P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), +39 more_

## Quotes

> "They really are such dear boys, you know. There’s to be no end of dances and drives and general jamborees. I shall never forgive you, Queen Anne, for not coming home with me for the holidays."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002)

> "There’ll be one or two quilting parties, I suppose; and all the old gossips will talk you over to your face and behind your back. You’ll die of lonesomeness, child."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Again P4](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0004)

> "Girls, dear, I’m tired to death. I feel like the man without a country—or was it without a shadow? I forget which. Anyway, I’ve been packing up."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Place P39](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0039)

> "Well, you looked it. But I admit my thoughts verged on the profane. And I have such a cold in the head—I can do nothing but sniffle, sigh and sneeze. Isn’t that alliterative agony for you? Queen Anne, do say something to cheer me up."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Place P43](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0043)

> "More alliteration. No, I don’t want Alec and Alonzo when I have a cold in the head. But what has happened you two? Now that I look at you closely you seem all lighted up with an internal iridescence. Why, you’re actually shining! What’s up?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Place P46](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0046)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phil-gordon.md)

Phil first meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at Old St. John's Cemetery during their freshman year at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), and they quickly become close friends and eventual housemates at Patty's Place.
